reason: The Admin zone context signature is an intentional compatibility-preserving addition: the context now carries the current actor and an optional surface subject. Property and taxonomy support adds nine new, purely additive Core migrations (property_sets, property_definitions, blueprint_property_sets, taxonomies, terms, page_term, page_property_values, term_property_values tables, plus a data migration syncing Core's built-in property sets) — no existing migration is modified or removed. Core explicitly declares psr/log for its protected reporting logger, retaining the same supported major versions as Laravel (^1.0|^2.0|^3.0). Operator routing adds one isolated reporting-incidents table with durable redacted delivery state. Existing migrations and stable signatures remain unchanged. The timestamp repair adds a forward-only Core migration that removes accidental MariaDB event and expiry updates while preserving existing values and insert defaults. Permission constraints now also admit major 8 while retaining majors 5 and 6: the used role, permission and team-context APIs are present in the cached 8.3.0 source. This widens dependency admission without changing any public signature or migration. Activitylog constraints now admit both majors 4 and 5 through one Core compatibility seam. An additive migration supplies the nullable attribute_changes column for existing hosts and preserves legacy properties and batch_uuid; existing stable signatures remain unchanged.
